messages:
Maya L: Quick postmortem follow-up: leader elections flickered during the spike and on-call exhausted retries. Need runbook + playbook changes: clear triage checklist, exact commands, and explicit escalation criteria. Ref: PMTKT-4520.
Jasper N: I'll own escalation matrix + who-to-page table. Plan: add 1-line "when to escalate to infra" and a decision tree for 5m/30m/1h windows. ETA: Wed 2025-07-02.
Rina P: I'll add the triage commands and a Quick Triage section for first responders. Draft commands I want to include:
```
# check cluster pod status
kubectl get pods -l app=redwood-shard -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,STATE:.status.phase,AGE:.metadata.creationTimestamp
# leader metric (promql)
max_over_time(leader_election_age_seconds[1m])
# check recent leader election errors
journalctl -u redwood-service --since "1 hour ago" | rg "leader-election.*failed"
```
Omar H: I'll coordinate adding alert playbook entries: add a rule to fire if >1 failover in 24h, and wire an auto-escalate to infra if sustained leader_age > 120s for 10m. Also add runbook links in alert payload.
ops-bot: postmortem PMTKT-4520 created by Maya L at 1746000001.
incident-bot: severity set to P2 at 1746000001. Follow-ups assigned.
Maya L: Action items (confirm):
- Escalation matrix + decision tree: Jasper N, ETA Wed 2025-07-02
- Quick triage + command snippets: Rina P, ETA Mon 2025-06-30
- Alert rule + auto-escalation wiring: Omar H, ETA Mon 2025-06-30
- Add recurring-incident tag + log retention policy (30d): Maya L, ETA Tue 2025-07-01
- Runbook QA with oncall (dry run tabletop): Rina P & Jasper N, target Thu 2025-07-03
Jasper N: I'll make the decision tree conservative: escalate to infra when leader_age >120s AND error rate > 0.5% for 5m. Will include exact phone and slack rotation for infra oncall.
Rina P: Adding a "quick grep" shortcut too: `rg "(leader-election|election).*error|panic" /var/log/redwood/*.log -n --context 3`
Omar H: I'll also add a short remediation checklist for SRE: step 1) verify dashboard (link), 2) run healthcheck script, 3) cordon & drain if node is unhealthy, 4) manual promo script with safety checks.
Maya L: Please react with :white_check_mark: when you accept ownership. I'll consolidate and create a single follow-up ticket that lists PRs and tracking.
Rina P: :white_check_mark: putting up PR with runbook draft tomorrow.
Jasper N: :white_check_mark: adding phone matrix and decision tree.
Omar H: :white_check_mark: filing alert PR (ALRT-609).
Maya L: Note on recurring incidents: link to Apr incident INC-2025-0412 shows same pattern. Let's add a 'recurring-incident' label to PMTKT-4520 and include search queries for correlated error signals. Also set a 30d retention for the leader-election logs to speed triage.
incident-bot: Reminder set: follow-up review in 7 days.
Maya L: Final: target to close all items in two weeks and schedule a 30-min runbook validation with oncall. Thanks team.
